lines: Euroclear CEO Valerie Urbain notes that the firm acts as essential global financial infrastructure, settling the equivalent of world GDP monthly and managing 45 trillion euros in assets.

Urbain highlights that the immobilization of 200 billion euros in Russian central bank assets requires balancing political sanctions with the legal certainty needed to preserve European market confidence.
The executive explains that despite advances in blockchain tokenization, European markets remain structurally fragmented by divergent national corporate, bankruptcy, and tax laws.
The program points out that transitioning to a T+0 settlement for institutional wholesale markets is currently impractical due to complex cross-border chains and time zone differences.
podcast: In Good Company with Nicolai Tangen
title: Euroclear CEO: Europe’s Financial Markets, Frozen Russian Assets and Tokenisation
